claim: The CloudFront geographic restrictions feature restricts access to all of the files of a distribution and at the country level; geographic restrictions apply to an entire distribution. A third-party geolocation service is the option to restrict access to a subset of the files or at a finer granularity than the country level, and to apply different restrictions to different parts of your content you create separate CloudFront distributions or use a third-party geolocation service.

evidence.quote: Use the CloudFront geographic restrictions feature. Use this option to restrict access to all of the files that are associated with a distribution and to restrict access at the country level.

Use a third-party geolocation service. Use this option to restrict access to a subset of the files that are associated with a distribution or to restrict access at a finer granularity than the country level.
Geographic restrictions apply to an entire distribution.

If you need to apply one restriction to part of your content and a different restriction (or no restriction) to another part of your content, you must create separate CloudFront distributions or [use a third-party geolocation service](#georestrictions-geolocation-service).
